en: Black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a small alpine village in a broad valley surrounded by dense conifer forests and dramatic vertical limestone cliffs and plateaus. A church with a tall steeple stands near the foreground, scattered farmhouses and chalets lie along a winding road, and towering rock walls rise behind the tree‑covered slopes. No visible caption or printed text appears on the image side.
